panzoom:

::: {.callout-note}
## About this page

This page **tests panzoom's options** one at a time: opting out with
`.nopanzoom` and `#| panzoom: false`, and the per-cell `caption`, `hint`,
`max-zoom`, `description` and `fit` options. The page itself sets
`loop: true`, so the gallery in case 8 wraps around. There is no lightbox,
so an image panzoom leaves alone opens nothing.

Each case says what to expect in its heading's attributes (`expect-open`,
`expect-caption`, `expect-hint`, `expect-max-zoom`, `expect-fit`), or on a
single image, and the browser test checks them.
:::

```{r}
#| include: false

wave <- function(k = 1) {
  x <- seq(0, 4 * pi, length.out = 400)
  plot(x, sin(k * x), type = "l", lwd = 2, col = hcl.colors(4)[k],
       main = paste("Wave", k), xlab = "x", ylab = "sin(kx)")
}
```

## 1. `.nopanzoom` inside a `.panzoom` div {#c1}

The first image is marked `.nopanzoom`, so panzoom leaves it alone: with no
lightbox on this page, clicking it does nothing. The second opens the
viewer.

::: {.panzoom layout-ncol="2"}
![Opted out.](../../images/mv-1.jpg){.nopanzoom expect-open="nothing"}

![Not opted out.](../../images/mv-2.jpg){expect-open="panzoom"}
:::

## 2. `#| panzoom: false` inside a `.panzoom` div {#c2 expect-open="nothing"}

The whole cell opts out.

::: {.panzoom}

```{r}
#| panzoom: false
#| fig-cap: "Opted out cell."

wave(1)
```

:::

## 3. `caption: false` {#c3 expect-open="panzoom" expect-caption="none"}

The figure has a caption on the page, but not in the viewer.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   caption: false
#| fig-cap: "This caption stays on the page."

wave(2)
```

## 4. `hint: false` {#c4 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="hidden"}

The page shows the hint (the default); this cell hides it.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   hint: false

wave(3)
```

## 5. Hint on by default {#c5 expect-open="panzoom" expect-hint="shown"}

```{r}
#| panzoom: true

wave(4)
```

## 6. `max-zoom: 2` {#c6 expect-open="panzoom" expect-max-zoom="2"}

Zooming in stops at 2 screen pixels per image pixel.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   max-zoom: 2

wave(1)
```

## 7. `description` cell option {#c7 expect-open="panzoom"}

The description is Markdown, with math, shown under the caption.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   description: "A sine wave, $y = \\sin(kx)$, **k = 2**."
#| fig-cap: "With a description."

wave(2)
```

## 8. `fit: height` on an ordinary plot {#c8 expect-open="panzoom" expect-fit="height"}

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   fit: height

wave(3)
```

## 9. `fit: width` on an ordinary plot {#c9 expect-open="panzoom" expect-fit="width"}

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   fit: width

wave(4)
```

## 10. Gallery with `loop: true` {#c10 expect-open="panzoom"}

Three plots in one gallery. With the page's `loop: true`, `←` on the first
goes to the last, and "previous" is never disabled.

```{r}
#| panzoom:
#|   group: waves
#| fig-cap:
#|   - "Wave one."
#|   - "Wave two."
#|   - "Wave three."

wave(1)
wave(2)
wave(3)
```
